releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.8 - Native 60 FPS Spectrum Visualizer
releaseNotes: Introduced real-time Native C++ 60 FPS FFT Spectrum Visualizer powered by an in-place Radix-2 FFT and Hann windowing directly in libmusicdeck_audio.so. Features 32 logarithmic frequency bands with natural ballistic physics, dynamic album-art gradient mapping, floating peak caps, and an instant ON/OFF toggle in the Player Menu.
